fees.label: Resident hunting license (2026-27 license year)
fees.notes: License year runs July 1 to June 30. Drawing applicants need the license for the matching license year.

fees.label: Nonresident hunting license (2026-27 license year)
fees.notes: Annual license. The $64.54 2-Day Nonresident license does not cover big game.

fees.label: Resident 1st deer tag/application
fees.notes: One item serves as the deer tag and the drawing application, including point-only (PD). There is no separate deer point fee.

fees.label: Nonresident 1st deer tag/application
fees.notes: One item serves as the tag and the application. If no tag is issued, the difference between the nonresident and resident fee may be refunded (CCR T14-708.2(b)).

fees.label: Resident 2nd deer tag/application
fees.notes: In the drawing, the Second-Deer Tag Drawing Application can be used only by junior hunters for apprentice hunts.

fees.label: Elk tag drawing application
fees.notes: Also what a point-only (499) application costs. The fee table says $8.38, but the Digest's elk/pronghorn/sheep page says '$8.13 nonrefundable processing fee'. The table value is used; the discrepancy is unresolved.

fees.label: Pronghorn tag drawing application
fees.notes: Also what a point-only (799) application costs. See the elk note on $8.13 vs $8.38.

fees.label: Bighorn sheep tag drawing application
fees.notes: Also what a point-only (599) application costs. See the elk note on $8.13 vs $8.38.

fees.label: Resident elk tag
fees.notes: Paid only if drawn. Due by 5:00 p.m. July 15, 2026.

fees.label: Nonresident elk tag
fees.notes: Paid only if drawn. Due by 5:00 p.m. July 15, 2026.

fees.label: Nonresident bighorn sheep tag
fees.notes: Paid only if drawn. Due to the License and Revenue Branch by 5:00 p.m. July 15, 2026.

fees.quote: minus the 2026 nonrefundable processing fee of $39.40

fees.label: Deer tag non-reporting fee
fees.notes: Charged if a deer tag harvest report isn't filed by January 31.

prerequisites.text: Buy the current-year California hunting license, then a drawing application for each species
prerequisites.quote: You will need to purchase a California hunting license and the appropriate Big Game Drawing Tag Application

prerequisites.text: Your CDFW license profile must show proof of hunter education (or a qualifying prior hunting license) before you can buy a license or apply
prerequisites.quote: You must have proof of hunter education on file to purchase hunting items online.

prerequisites.text: Elk and pronghorn: you must be at least 12 by July 1 and hold a valid 2026-27 California hunting license. Only one nonresident can draw an elk tag, and one a pronghorn tag, each year
prerequisites.quote: Only one nonresident may be drawn for an elk or pronghorn tag annually.

prerequisites.text: Elk and pronghorn: only residents can apply as a party (of two). Nonresidents must apply alone
prerequisites.quote: Nonresidents cannot apply as a party for elk or pronghorn tags.

prerequisites.text: Bighorn sheep: you must be at least 16 by July 1, hold a valid 2026-27 hunting license and never have drawn a California bighorn tag (once in a lifetime). No party applications. Nonresidents get no more than 10% of tags
prerequisites.quote: must not have drawn a California bighorn sheep tag in any prior year. Not more than 10 percent of the bighorn sheep tags shall be awarded to non-residents each year.

prerequisites.text: Bighorn sheep: hunters who draw must complete a mandatory hunter orientation
Premium deer: apply with the First-Deer Tag Drawing Application, not a First-Deer Tag. Deer parties can have up to six people
prerequisites.quote: You must use your First-Deer Tag Drawing Application to apply for a premium deer hunt tag.

prerequisites.text: One application per species. Duplicate applications are rejected
prerequisites.quote: By law, you may only submit one application for each species.

notes: All dates and fees come from the 2026 Big Game Hunting Digest (updated 4/17/2026), which was CDFW's newest on 2026-11-04. The Hunting-Digest page lists no 2027 Digest yet, so every draw is status last_year. CDFW's Big Game page says applications are available 'each year on April 15 through June 2' with a midnight June 2 deadline. 2027 will probably follow that pattern, but it isn't published, so it isn't recorded as 2027. A 2027 license fee schedule wasn't found on wildlife.ca.gov. California has no moose or mountain goat hunts. Elk/pronghorn/sheep drawing application fee: the fee table says $8.38, but the elk/pronghorn/sheep page says '$8.13 nonrefundable processing fee'. The table value is used. Deer has no separate point fee because the deer tag/application fee is paid up front. Successful elk/pronghorn/sheep applicants are notified by mail by July 2, 2026, and their tag fee is due by 5:00 p.m. July 15, 2026. Leftover premium deer tags go on sale July 2 at 8:00 a.m. Nothing was blocked.
